$Classic Controller
*By Vague Rant and quatric
*Cars: Mater-National (Europe: De, It) (RC2Y78)
*Play with a Classic Controller (or Pro): left stick steers, ZL / the C-stick jumps.
*Needs a Wii Remote with a Classic Controller attached.
* Classic Controller hook

$GameCube controller
*By quatric
*Cars: Mater-National (Europe: De, It) (RC2Y78)
*Play with a GameCube controller in ports 1-4 (a Wii Remote must still be connected).
*Needs the Classic Controller code above as well: enable both.
* KPADRead entry: keep the GameCube ports probed and polled
